1000 journaled conversations + 1 legacy conversation: 1 checkpoint snapshot and 1 legacy MAX query; sparse coverage and target preserved; read errors remain errors.
Initial and ordinary message readiness precedes auxiliary metadata. Profile failure stays retryable, does not publish syncFailed, and does not replay saved messages.
